newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia KFC says chief Ting quits.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia KFC says chief Ting quits.

text.p: Malaysian fast-food restaurant operator KFC Holdings (M) Bhd said George Ting has tendered his resignation as chief executive officer and managing director of the company.
The company in its two-paragraph statement did not say why Ting quit with immediate effect to become adviser of the group.
KFC also did not say who would replace him.
The statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange was signed by KFC's group executive director Harris Beh.
Ting, Beh and other company officials were not immediately available for comment.
Around 0755 GMT, KFC stock was down 50 cents to 10.10 ringgit on volume of 1.18 million shares traded.
